name: python
description: A Python interpreter. Use this to execute python code when you need to perform calculations, data analysis, or verify code snippets. The output will be the result of the last expression or any print statements. All code is executed in a persistent stateful session.

code.description: The Python code to be executed.

name: google_search
description: Search the web using Google. This tool is useful for finding documentation, error solutions, and up-to-date information about programming libraries and frameworks. It can take multiple queries at once to provide a comprehensive search.

queries.description: A list of search queries to execute.
